{"draft": "West Pharmaceutical Services Q3 2026
Results:
- Net sales: $874.5 million, up 8.7% from a year earlier; organic growth was 11.9%
- Diluted EPS: $3.02, climbed 57.3%
- Adjusted-diluted EPS: $2.66, rose 35.7%
Segments:
- High-Value Product Components net sales: $466.7 million, jumped 19.7%; organic growth was 20.3%
- High-Value Product Delivery Devices net sales: $99.1 million, flat; organic growth excluding foreign currency translation effects and the SmartDose® 3.5mL divestiture impact was 26.4%
- Standard Products net sales: $163.0 million, grew 2.9%
- West Vantage accounted for 17% of total company net sales
Cash and capital:
- Stock repurchases: $231 million in the quarter, bringing the year-to-date total to $685 million
- Year-to-date operating cash flow: $403 million; capital expenditures were $125 million
- Fourth-quarter dividend declared: $0.26 per share, up 18% over the prior quarter
Outlook:
- Full-year 2026 net sales guidance: $3.41 billion to $3.42 billion
- Full-year 2026 adjusted-diluted EPS guidance: $9.38 to $9.48"}
